turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook?
Funny. Was he heard, yes or no?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You'd bet. My son wrote that essay, so show me what you have besides a wager.
